name: new_v2_grabmyo_cross_day_independent_v1_family_extension_v1
source_state: F0v2 Rest thresholds and four candidate metadata states fit Day1 Rest only; scaler/classifier fit all Day1 recordings. Day2 and Day3 never fit state.
classifier: StandardScaler plus LogisticRegression C=1 max_iter=2000 random_state=20260924, identical to frozen GRAB day study
aggregation: mean and standard deviation of twenty disjoint 250 ms windows per native recording
selection: Maximize pooled Day2 macro-F1, break ties by lower Day2 log loss. Day3 never selects arms; report minimum-user F1.
scope: Independent first-stage screening of four additional eight-channel feature families on public three-day GRABMyo. Same 672 official-hash-verified recordings and native day partitions as frozen parent. Repeated subjects across days, no unseen-person inference. No historical formula or own-device/live claim.
